title: Advanced JSON Management for Business Central Developers
summary: Codeunit 5459 JSON Management provides a comprehensive toolset for reading, writing, and converting JSON in Business Central AL code. It simplifies complex data handling by grouping procedures into Read, Write, and Convert categories, with special attention to SaaS-safe operations for cloud deployments.
key_points: JSON Management holds JSON data within the codeunit variable, eliminating the need to manage separate JSONObject variables
Read operations extract values using property names, dot-separated paths, or array indices with flexible return types
Write operations build JSON structures by initializing objects/collections and using SetValue, AddArrayValue, or AddJson methods
Convert operations transform between JSON and XML formats or format decimals as JSON properties
On-Prem-only procedures exist but should be avoided in SaaS environments for cloud compatibility

quotes.text: Codeunit 5459 - JSON Management is one of the most comprehensive helper units in Business Central.
quotes.why_it_matters: Establishes the scope and importance of the tool for developers working with JSON

quotes.text: The key thing to know about using this code unit is the persistence of data inside the code unit.
quotes.why_it_matters: Highlights the key architectural advantage that distinguishes JSON Management from direct JSONObject usage

quotes.text: When using Codeunit 5459, remember to configure your AI-assisted development tools carefully. Specify that you want to avoid any procedures flagged as OnPrem.
quotes.why_it_matters: Critical guidance for maintaining cloud compatibility in SaaS Business Central environments
